In one period, a wave travels a distance $\lambda$ (see Figure 70e).
Its speed is therefore given by
$v=\frac{\lambda}{T}$ (4.1)

resolvedSectionBreaks.before: **Wave speed equals wavelength multiplied by the vibration frequency**.
resolvedSectionBreaks.after: When a wave travels along a string, we can observe two kinds of periodicity.

resolvedSectionBreaks.before:
Each point on the string repeats its motion periodically.
For harmonic sine or cosine motion, all points have the same frequency and amplitude, but differ in phase.
resolvedSectionBreaks.after:
